ideons.name: Hunting Tendril
ideons.text: Strikes the weakest orthogonally adjacent Ally for 4 Water, gaining 2 damage each successive command. Otherwise moves one orthogonal space toward the weakest Ally, swapping with player cards and whole Constructs, then checks distance: strike if now adjacent, otherwise Splash against that Ally. Splash starts at 1 Water, gains 0.5 each successive command, rounded up. Each replacement resets both attacks to their starting damage. With no Allies, moves left and Splashes the player from its column after movement (Guard only in that column or farther left; equipment also works). If it starts at the left edge, inflicts Poison 2 instead. Killing tendrils increases their replacements. Returns are warned on the killing card's space, wait one full player turn, then destroy the card or Construct there. Extra returns warn nearby spaces.

enemies.name: The Cnidarian
enemies.signature: Begins with three hunting tendrils. They strike adjacent Allies for 4 Water (+2 each successive command); otherwise move one orthogonal space toward the weakest Ally, swapping past player cards and Constructs, then strike if adjacent after moving, otherwise Splash that Ally for 1 Water (+0.5 each successive command, rounded up). Replacements start again at 4 strike / 1 Splash. Without Allies they move left and Splash the player from their resulting column, or inflict Poison 2 instead when starting at the left edge. Deaths 1–3 replace one-for-one, 4–6 two-for-one, then three-for-one. Replacements warn the killing card's space (extras nearby), give one full player turn of reprieve, then erupt after survivors act, destroying any card or Construct left there. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Race the owner while selectively cutting aging tendrils to reset their damage. Killing every tendril makes the brood grow.
